Dear Members of the Board,  

I am writing to formally resign from my role as Chief Executive Officer of Meta Platforms, Inc., effective [Effective Date]. After careful consideration, I have decided that stepping down is the best decision for me and for the company at this time.  

I am grateful for the opportunity to have led Meta and to have worked alongside so many dedicated colleagues. I remain committed to supporting a smooth transition and will assist in any way that is helpful during the handover period.  

Thank you for your trust and collaboration. I wish the company continued success in the future.
